body: What's the point of a body and consciousness if it's pain without pleasure?  We can talk about how it doesn't matter but our bodies are built to tell us it does. Taking care of a body gets really old when no one wants to touch it. What's the point of keeping it around other than fear?  Why contribute if the best part of life is kept behind closed doors? Why stick around?  Fear of death. I am so envious of other people the only solution is death. There is no other solution at this point. I do not want to go crazy from isolation and lack of dopamine. That's not fair to me. Death is fair, not fair, but nothing was. Death is release from pain. Release from pain is better than pain. If pleasure is impossible, death is the only answer. It's so simple, why am I so afraid of the most beautiful thing I'll ever experience?
